card_removal.note: Rest-site card removal. A rest node may override this block with its own "card_removal" entry.

acts.note: Maps of a normal run in order. Reaching the exit of one map leads to the next; the exit of the last map completes the run. heal_between_acts: share of max HP every party member recovers on reaching the next act (fallen members rise with it).

loot.note: Equipment drops after a won fight: chance of one item, rarity weights. Only items somebody in the party can use as she is (princess and specialization) drop. shop: gear offers each merchant adds per visit.

shop_services.note: Gold services of every merchant besides its item stock. A shop may override any part with its own shop_services entry. Removal and upgrade prices rise by price_step for every use in the run.

difficulty.note: Enemy HP and attack damage multipliers (1.0 = the enemy data). elite_* and boss_* multiply on top for those fights. Tuned with tests/combat/run_simulation.gd (BALANCE.md).

relics.note: Relic rewards: every won elite fight leaves one relic (elite_weights by rarity); a boss offers boss_choices boss relics to choose from. Chests roll their own (data/treasure).
